outcome: Correlation of Ret-He with perinatal factors
cohort: Infants with a clinically indicated blood sample obtained within 24 h after birth, including very preterm (<30 weeks GA), moderately preterm (30-36 weeks GA), and term (≥37 weeks GA) infants.
finding: Gestational age at birth has a negligible impact on Ret-He, and the lower limit of the normal reference range in newborns within 24 h after birth can be set to 25 pg.
mod_finding: There was a slight variation in Ret-He with mode of delivery.
